settings.heading: Our promise
settings.body: We offer 7-day size exchanges from the date of delivery. Your first size exchange within this window is free.

settings.heading: Eligibility
settings.body:
• Requested within 7 days of delivery.
  • Item is unworn, unwashed, and undamaged.
  • Original tags are intact and the piece is in its original condition.

settings.heading: How to request an exchange
settings.body: Email us at thodasoft@gmail.com or message us on WhatsApp with your order number and the size you’d like. We’ll guide you through the rest.

settings.heading: Refunds & store credit
settings.body: We currently offer exchanges and store credit rather than cash refunds, except where an item arrives defective or incorrect — in which case we’ll replace it or refund you in full.

settings.heading: Defective or wrong items
settings.body: If your order arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos and we’ll make it right at no cost to you.

settings.heading: Non-exchangeable items
settings.body: For hygiene reasons, certain items may not be eligible for exchange; this will be noted on the product page where applicable.

settings.heading: Need help?
settings.body: See our Size Guide to get the fit right the first time, or reach us via our contact page.

settings.heading: Returns & Exchanges
settings.intro: We want you to love the fit. If the size isn’t right, we offer easy exchanges.
